topic: Universal Public Transport and Accessible Mobility Bill

findings.title: Constitution of India, Article 14, Article 19(1)(d), Article 21, Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016
findings.limitations: Freedom of movement encompasses right to accessible, affordable public transport.

gaps: Absence of statutory radius mandates for public transit stops (1 km urban radius).
Inadequate disability accessibility across bus fleets and transit hubs.
